{'translation': 'Over the past year, we have been eagerly anticipating the next-generation iPad mini update, and the announcement appears to be just around the corner. Aaron Perris revealed last week that the new device will feature an A20 Pro chip and narrower screen borders, and we already know it will come with an OLED display and a water-resistant design.', 'notes': 'Perris last week disclosed that the new product will come with an A20 Pro chip and slimmer screen bezels, and we already know it will adopt an OLED screen and feature a water-resistant design.'}

{'translation': 'Although these upgrades are already quite appealing, my main expectation for the next iPad mini actually lies on the software side.', 'notes': 'While these upgrades are already pretty tempting, what I am mainly hoping for from the next iPad mini is actually on the software front.'}

{'translation': "After seeing iPhone Duo, I have been thoroughly impressed by Apple's multitasking capabilities. The multitasking experience on iPad has always felt rather chaotic to me, whereas iPhone Duo comes across as elegant and seamless.", 'notes': "After watching iPhone Duo, I have gained a new appreciation for Apple's multitasking capabilities. The iPad multitasking experience has always felt messy to me, but iPhone Duo feels elegant and smooth in comparison."}

{'translation': 'On a screen this small, traditional window management has never really suited the iPad mini. Users would unlikely stack too many windows on it. So I hope Apple can borrow a practical feature from iPhone Duo: Split View combined with Picture-in-Picture.', 'notes': "On such a small screen, traditional window operations have never really suited the iPad mini. Users probably wouldn't stack too many windows on it. So I hope Apple can take a cue from a practical feature of iPhone Duo: Split View combined with Picture-in-Picture."}

{'translation': 'What I mean is, this experience is truly first-class. Currently on the iPad mini, the Picture-in-Picture window cannot span the full width of the screen in portrait mode; even when it can, it either covers part of the app content, or you have to manually resize it via the window controls.', 'notes': "I mean, this experience is really top-notch. Right now on the iPad mini, the Picture-in-Picture window cannot take up the full width of the screen in portrait mode; even when it can, it either blocks part of the App's content, or you have to manually resize it through the window controls."}

{'translation': "Bringing split video and App view to the iPad mini's screen feels like a no-brainer to me, especially considering the similar screen aspect ratio between the iPhone Duo and the iPad mini. At least for me personally, if this feature were available, I would use the iPad mini in portrait mode a lot more often.", 'notes': "Bringing split video and App view to the iPad mini's screen is, to me, a no-brainer — especially given that the iPhone Duo and iPad mini share a similar screen aspect ratio. At least for me personally, if this feature were usable, I'd reach for the iPad mini in portrait mode a whole lot more."}
